name.value: Comox and District Fish and Game Campground

description.value: A fish-and-game club campground on Colake Road near Courtenay, open year-round but restricted to club members; staffed May–September with a boat launch, archery range, and shooting facilities on the grounds.

raw_osm.name: Comox and District Fish and Game Campground
raw_osm.operator: Comox and District Fish and Game Protective Association

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the campground is operational at 3780 Colake Road, Comox-Strathcona, run by the Courtenay and District Fish and Game Protective Association. The campground page states it is 'open all year for members,' with staffed hosting in summer months, indicating year-round access may be restricted to club members; the OSM access=permissive tag suggests some public access, but this conflicts with the members-first language on the site and creates ambiguity for touring cyclists. No cycling-specific amenities (showers, hiker/biker sites, tools, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all optional amenities default to null.
concerns: OSM name uses 'Comox and District' but the operating association is consistently called 'Courtenay and District Fish and Game Protective Association' on the website and in the domain (courtenayfishandgame.org) — likely an OSM name error.
Year-round camping is explicitly described as 'for members'; it is unclear whether non-members (e.g., touring cyclists) can camp here at all without joining the association.
No phone number or address present in OSM record; phone (250) 338-0850 and address 3780 Colake Road taken from website only — contact_confirmed set to null for both.
The facility is primarily a fish and game club with firearms ranges on the same grounds, which may be a poor fit for a cycling tourism audience and warrants editorial judgement.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The campground website states it is 'open all year for members,' raising genuine uncertainty about whether touring cyclists without club membership can access it; the public-facing campground host contact and OSM access=permissive hint at seasonal public access, but this needs explicit confirmation before a WWC listing is appropriate.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground host contact (staffed season): (250) 338-5159 / campground@courtenayfishandgame.org. Club mailing address: PO Box 3177, Courtenay, BC V9N 5N4.
